# Bank of America

> Bank of America provides comprehensive financial services including banking, credit cards, loans, mortgages, and investment management through digital and in-person channels.

Bank of America is a leading financial institution offering retail and investment banking services through multiple platforms including mobile apps, online banking, and physical financial centers. The site features products from Bank of America and its subsidiaries including Merrill Investment Management and U.S. Trust.

## Key Topics

- Banking Products
- Credit Cards
- Mortgages
- Auto Loans
- Mobile Banking
- Online Banking
- Investment Services
- Merrill
- Account Security
- Customer Service
- Financial Education
- Checking Accounts
- Savings Accounts
- Appointment Scheduling
- FDIC/SIPC Protection

## Core Banking Products

- [Bank of America - Banking, Credit Cards, Loans and Merrill Investing](https://www.bankofamerica.com): Bank of America homepage with banking, credit cards, loans, and investing services
- [Bank of America Advantage Banking: Open a Checking Account Today](https://www.bankofamerica.com/deposits/checking/checking-accounts): Advantage Banking checking account product page with online account opening
- [Open a Bank of America Advantage Savings Account Online](https://www.bankofamerica.com/deposits/savings/savings-accounts): Advantage Savings Account product page for opening savings accounts online
- [Credit Cards: Find & Apply for a Credit Card Online at Bank of America](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards): Credit card finder and comparison tool with cash back, rewards, and travel options

## Lending Products

- [Mortgages - Home Mortgage Loans from Bank of America](https://www.bankofamerica.com/mortgage/home-mortgage): Home mortgage loans with rates, calculators, and prequalification for homebuyers
- [Auto Loans & Car Financing from Bank of America](https://www.bankofamerica.com/auto-loans): Auto loans and car financing for new, used, and refinance options

## Digital Banking & Mobile

- [Bank of America Mobile Banking](https://www.bankofamerica.com/online-banking/iphone-banking-app.go): Mobile banking app for iPhone, iPad, and Android with account management features

## Customer Support & Resources

- [Schedule an Appointment - Bank of America](https://secure.bankofamerica.com/mycommunications/public/appointments/getTopics.go): Secure appointment scheduling with banking and investment specialists
- [Schedule an Appointment - Bank of America](https://secure.bankofamerica.com/secure-mycommunications/public/appointments): Secure portal for scheduling appointments with banking and investment advisors
- [Bank of America Financial Centers and ATMs](https://locators.bankofamerica.com): Financial center and ATM locator tool to find branches and banking locations

## Financial Education

- [Personal Finance Education & Tips from Better Money Habits](https://bettermoneyhabits.bankofamerica.com/en): Better Money Habits financial education and money management tips for all life stages
